description: This file defines an abstract class 'PlacementFilterStrategy' used for filtering silos for grain placement in Orleans. It includes methods for initialization, populating grain properties, and retrieving specific placement filter properties.

classes.name: PlacementFilterStrategy
classes.description: An abstract class representing a strategy for filtering silos for grain placement, with methods for initialization and property population.

methods.name: PlacementFilterStrategy
methods.description: Constructor that sets the initial order value.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the strategy with grain properties, parsing the 'order' property.

methods.name: AdditionalInitialize
methods.description: Virtual method for additional initialization, can be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: PopulateGrainProperties
methods.description: Populates grain properties with placement filter information and additional properties.

methods.name: GetPlacementFilterGrainProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a specific placement filter property value from grain properties.

methods.name: GetAdditionalGrainProperties
methods.description: Virtual method returning additional grain properties, can be overridden by subclasses.
